title: 视频

series.next: 老周 has read it. He's typing… He's still typing.

setting: 金桂苑, Monday, 8 pm. The waltz video is everywhere, and a TV station wants 老周.

giveup.zh: 小邻居不说话，就是同意上电视了。
giveup.en: Our young neighbour's gone quiet. That's a yes to the TV, then.
By morning there's a camera crew outside 3号楼, and 老周 is hiding in the bike shed. Run that back. 🍉

wu.name: 吴阿姨
wu.en: 3号楼: knows someone who saw it

zhao.name: 赵奶奶
zhao.en: eighty, sends only sixty-second voice notes

laozhou.name: 老周
laozhou.en: 3号楼: wishes the video would go away

fang.name: 方阿姨
fang.en: 7号楼: the waltz partner whose knee went

steps.narr: Monday evening. The estate's group chat.

steps.zh: 全网都在转：两百个人一起拍手！
steps.en: It's all over the internet: two hundred people clapping along!

else.zh: 赵奶奶的独唱，有自己的粉丝页了！
else.en: 赵奶奶's solo has its own fan page now!

steps.zh: 我拍得最响，你们看第三排！
steps.en: I'm clapping loudest. Look at the third row!

else.en: Hello, my fans! It's 赵奶奶!

steps.zh: 大新闻：电视台要采访老周！
steps.en: Big news: a TV station wants to interview 老周!

steps.zh: 上电视！金桂苑要出名了！
steps.en: On TV! 金桂苑's going to be famous!
My dad doesn't want to go on TV.

steps.zh: 老周，机会难得啊！小邻居，你说是不是？
steps.en: 老周, it's a chance in a million! Young neighbour, isn't it?

say.en: Back 老周 up: he shouldn't do the interview.
say.gloss: Uncle Zhou, don't do the interview.
say.tip: 接受 jiēshòu = accept: 接受采访 = give an interview. 周叔叔 is how you'd address 老周.

ok.zh: 可是电视台的车已经在楼下了！
ok.en: But the TV van's already downstairs!

fail.zh: 小邻居也觉得应该去，对吧？
fail.en: Our young neighbour thinks he should go too, right?

answers: 您不想去，就别接受采访了。
4.gloss: If you don't want to, don't do the interview.

steps.en: If you ask me, 老周's just shy!
Exactly. I'll go down and speak for him!

say.en: Tell the aunties: the man wants some peace.
say.gloss: Aunties, the man wants some peace.
say.tip: 人家 rénjia = someone else, said kindly: 人家想安静 = he'd like some peace.

ok.zh: 说得对！大家安静！让老周歇歇！
ok.en: Quite right! Everyone hush! Let 老周 rest!

answers: 阿姨们，人家想安静，让他歇歇吧。
4.gloss: Aunties, he wants some peace. Let him rest.

steps.narr: The group goes quiet. For almost a minute.

steps.zh: 老周，有句话我想跟你说：我喜欢你，一年了。
steps.en: 老周, there's something I want to tell you: I like you. I have for a year.

steps.narr: Under it, the phone's 转文字, the voice note in text:
steps.zh: 老周，有句话我想跟你说：我喜欢你，一年了。
字太小了，我看不清。她说的什么呀？
steps.en: The writing's too small, I can't see it. What did she say?

say.en: Read it for 赵奶奶: what did 方阿姨 say?
answers: 她说她喜欢老周，一年了。
方阿姨喜欢老周一年了！
say.gloss: She says she likes 老周, and has for a year.
say.tip: 喜欢 xǐhuan = like, be fond of. 一年了 = for a year now.

answers: 方阿姨说，她已经喜欢老周一年了。
4.gloss: 方阿姨 says she's liked 老周 for a whole year.

steps.en: ...Did I send that to the wrong chat?

say.en: Tell 方阿姨 to recall it, quick, or tell her it was well said.
say.tip: 撤回 chèhuí = recall, unsend: you get two minutes.

ok.zh: 撤回了也没用，我们都听了三遍了。
ok.en: No use recalling it. We've all listened three times.

then.en: 方阿姨, I'm on your side!

fail.en: What do I do, what do I do...

answers: 方阿姨，两分钟内还能撤回，快！
4.gloss: 方阿姨, you can still recall it within two minutes. Quick!

answers: 方阿姨，说得好！我们都支持你！
alts.gloss: Well said, 方阿姨! We're all with you!

steps.en: The voice note is gone. All hundred and twenty-eight of you heard it anyway. 🍉

else.en: Forty-two thumbs-up under 方阿姨's voice note, and counting. 🍉
